scope: Bounded sanitized startup diagnostics, package source binding and exceptional child cleanup. No Linux/cloud/runtime qualification.

closedFinding.disposition: Exception after spawn now runs one TERM/2second wait then one KILL/2second wait if required. Original BaseException is re-raised; bounded cleanup facts attached separately and persisted best-effort, never raw failure. stdout-close failure cannot replace original.
closedFinding.independentRegression: Actual disposable children under injected third-fsync ENOSPC, including SIGTERM-ignoring child, reaped with original exception identity and no sentinel disclosure. Synthetic unreapable child retains failed flag and two bounded waits.

observations: Normal forwarded-signal and child-exit tests preserved; no retries or additional node service.
Existing systemd whole-service stop/45second limit and independent shutdown controls retained as outer bound for hung/unreapable processes.
Exact packaged startup source hash checked before node execution and safe receipt helper; changed helper rejected, old missing-helper packages fail closed.
Finite fixed startup/error enums, bounded byte parsing and owner-only records; no raw logs, arguments, URLs, capabilities or stack traces serialized.
User-data16KiB cap and realistic-capability-size tests remain passing; deployment must freshly generate exact payload and package hashes.
limitations: No Docker, Linux systemd, real archive build, cloud launch, signing, secret reads or actual node qualification performed.
Previous remote node startup failure remains unexplained. Observed categories are diagnostic signatures, not readiness or proven causes.
Root must rebuild package and verify exact payload/manifest plus live budget and shutdown controls before any paid use.
